reason: In sync mode `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:5-11,16` parses with `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, whose two computed keys both evaluate to "[object Object]", so the schema is effectively `{access_token}` and zod strips `expires_in` (the offset-to-timestamp transform at `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:53-55` is also skipped). The merge at `CalendarService.ts:264` therefore persists the stale `expires_in`, and `getToken` at `CalendarService.ts:278-281` sees it as expired and refreshes on every call.
